page: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard.A2.Flex.1-8 is an entry-level general-purpose virtual machine configuration based on the ARM64 architecture. It provides 2 dedicated physical cores and 2 vCPUs operating at 3.0 GHz, powered by Ampere AmpereOne Ampere-1 processors with 1 thread per core. The instance is allocated 8.0 GB of system RAM, maintaining a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio. Hardware encryption capabilities include hardware AES acceleration, though advanced vector or matrix extensions such as AVX-512 or AMX are not present on this ARM platform. The server includes one complimentary public IPv4 address, contains no bundled local storage, and does not include GPU acceleration.

Benchmark evaluations place this small configuration in the entry-level performance tier. Compute testing records a Geekbench single-core score of 875.0 and multi-core score of 1515.0, alongside a PassMark CPU score of 1443.91. Memory throughput shows cached small-block reads at 167.95 GB/sec, while uncached large-block transfers register 7.47 GB/sec for reads and 9.24 GB/sec for writes. Workload-specific metrics show Redis SET throughput reaching 2.6 million operations per second and static web serving throughput measuring 2.73 GB/sec. Low-overhead text processing achieves 1183.0 points and Clang software compilation reaches 2315.0 points in Geekbench testing.

Because the instance relies entirely on remote block volumes for persistence and features modest compute bandwidth, it represents a cost-effective choice for lightweight non-critical workloads rather than resource-intensive computational tasks. The dedicated single-threaded ARM cores provide predictable execution without hyperthreading contention. VM.Standard.A2.Flex.1-8 is suited for microservices, lightweight web servers, basic CI/CD runners, internal development environments, and low-traffic API endpoints.
description: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard.A2.Flex.1-8 is a general-purpose virtual machine built on the 64-bit ARM architecture. Powered by Ampere AmpereOne Ampere-1 processors clocked at 3.0 GHz, the instance delivers 2 dedicated physical cores with 2 vCPUs and 8.0 GB of RAM. The instance lacks bundled local storage and GPU hardware, depending on network storage for persistence, but includes a complimentary public IPv4 address. Across synthetic benchmarks, the machine achieves a Geekbench single-core score of 875.0, a multi-core score of 1515.0, and 2.6 million Redis SET operations per second. Memory performance measures 167.95 GB/sec for cached small-block reads and 7.47 GB/sec for uncached read streams. With dedicated ARM cores avoiding hyperthreading interference, VM.Standard.A2.Flex.1-8 is best matched for lightweight web hosting, microservices, small development environments, and low-scale edge services.
